issues.desc: background.md CORRECTION paragraph (## Solution Tradeoffs, final sentence) refers to "cross-vendor review host B" as the source of the correction without defining the term anywhere in background.md itself. It is inferable from context that this is some external/independent reviewer that caught a transcription error, and the term is an established convention elsewhere in this repo (see docs/requirements/decisions/tier-c-crosshost-quorum-threat-model.md: host A = Claude, host B = Codex), but a newly-onboarded reader with only background.md in hand cannot resolve exactly what a "cross-vendor review host" is or how it relates to this story. Does not block understanding of the core bug/fix content, so kept as low/advisory.
